# Foundation Checklist: Project Scaffold with Hello World Endpoint

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of US-01 requirements and their supporting plan.
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all US-01 deliverables—initial contracts, temporary Hello endpoint, generated API reference, tests, quality commands, commit safeguard, and CI/release workflows—represented in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Are the declared domain and application concepts described sufficiently to distinguish type contracts from later runtime behavior? [Completeness, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 3, §Key Entities; Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK003 Is the temporary status of `GET /hello` and its planned retirement when the product endpoint arrives explicit? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, §Acceptance Scenario 7; Plan §Structure Decision]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Are the Hello response's method, path, status, media type, and exact body stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 1, §FR-002; contracts/hello-api.md]
- [x] CHK005 Is “deterministic” acceptance coverage defined clearly enough to exclude dependence on the live Hacker News site? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 2, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is “all required quality gates” tied clearly to the authoritative QA Approach rather than left as an undefined list? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 6, §FR-007; Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Do the spec, API-contract summary, and plan describe the same `GET /hello` response? [Consistency, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 1; Plan §Project Structure; contracts/hello-api.md]
- [x] CHK008 Is the `HackerNewsEntry` name used consistently despite the architecture example's shorter `Entry` label? [Consistency, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 3; Plan §Structure Decision; data-model.md]
- [x] CHK009 Are the exclusions on retrieval, parsing, filtering, and persistence consistent across functional requirements, assumptions, and plan scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009, §Assumptions; Plan §Summary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Can each functional requirement be traced to at least one acceptance scenario or explicitly referenced authoritative criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-009, §Acceptance Scenarios]
- [x] CHK011 Are success criteria stated with objective outcomes or a clear review standard, rather than relying on words such as “minimal” or “matches”? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK012 Are the required CI and release outcomes measurable, including blocking on failed gates and publishing the same verified artifact? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 6–7, §FR-007–FR-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Do the scenarios cover both the Hello response and the supporting project-foundation deliverables needed for US-01? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 1–4]
- [x] CHK014 Are both outcomes of the local commit safeguard specified, including failing and passing unit-test runs? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 5, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are pull-request verification and tagged-release publication covered as distinct delivery scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 6–7, §FR-007–FR-008]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Is the expected treatment of requests to unknown paths either specified or explicitly delegated to the general HTTP contract? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Given that `GET /hello` has no parameters or request body, is the absence of input-validation scenarios an intentional scope choice? [Coverage, Assumption, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 1, contracts/hello-api.md]
- [x] CHK018 Are failed or incomplete required checks clearly distinguished from successful pull-request and release outcomes? [Exception Flow, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 6–7, §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Is the absence of endpoint latency or throughput targets justified for this temporary scaffold, or does the requirement need a measurable service target? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK020 Are authentication, privacy, and data-handling requirements either specified or explicitly scoped out for the Hello endpoint? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Assumptions; docs/requirements/product_backlog.md §Out of scope]
- [x] CHK021 Are workflow permission and credential expectations sufficiently referenced for reviewers to assess delivery security? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions; docs/delivery/ci-cd.md §Security and traceability principles]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK022 Is the Node.js 26 LTS baseline and its use in both local development and GitHub-hosted CI stated consistently? [Assumption, Plan §Technical Context; quickstart.md]
- [x] CHK023 Are the OpenAPI source, generated reference, and their dependency on the contract-first sequence explicit? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003; Plan §Constraints; contracts/hello-api.md]
- [x] CHK024 Are the project architecture, QA gates, and CI/CD model identified as the authoritative sources for detailed requirements? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Constraints]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK025 Is “applicable tests” precise enough to identify required HTTP integration and acceptance coverage without prescribing test implementation details? [Ambiguity, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 2, §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK026 Is the term “project foundation” bounded by explicit deliverables and exclusions rather than open to unrelated scaffold work? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK027 Is the distinction between the temporary `/hello` operation and the later product filtering operation clear throughout the requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §Acceptance Scenario 7; docs/requirements/product_backlog.md §US-10]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
